notes: Highlighted pins in the image: GND is the left-column pin in the 5th row (physical pin 9 = GND.2); GP17 is the left-column pin in the 6th row (physical pin 11 = GPIO17).
Black wire runs from Pi GND to breadboard hole 15a; purple wire runs from GPIO17 to hole 18a.
The buzzer covers the right part of the top bank, so its legs are assumed to be in column e of rows 15 and 18 (same strips as the wire ends in column a).
Buzzer polarity: port 1 (positive, long leg) is assumed to go to the GPIO17 row (18) and port 2 (negative) to the GND row (15).
No resistor is used, as the manual states. The manual covers the active buzzer, not the passive one.
